CHAPTER.VERS: Keep me, O God, for in you I take refuge.
I said to the , “You are my ,my happiness rests in you alone.
Those who are holy in the land,they, they alone, are the noble ones;all my delight is in them.”
Those who choose other godsfind endless sorrow.In their offerings of blood I will have no partnor take their name on my lips.
The is my share and my portion,my fate is in your strong hands.
The boundary lines of my lifemark out delightful country,my heritage pleases me well.
I praise the for his counsel,which so stirs my heart in the night.
I keep the always in mind:with him at my hand, I can never be moved.
